_comment: Repository coverage policy: 100% line AND branch, no exclusions.
'floor' is the enforced ratchet - CI fails below it. Raise it as tests land;
never lower it. 'target' is the policy itself and does not move.
Baseline recorded 2026-09-08: no test project and no CI existed before it.
Raised 2026-09-09 when GeneralViewModel gained tests: 28 tests now cover
SessionLabel and GeneralViewModel, the two classes at 100%.
coverage.runsettings strips compiler-generated code before counting - the
GeneratedRegex source generator output and Avalonia XamlClosure types. That
is not a policy exclusion, it is code nobody wrote; leaving it in inflated
the denominator and put 100% out of reach by construction.
The honest reading: the app is still almost entirely untested. What remains
is Avalonia views, System.Speech interop and the Velopack updater - parts
that need real seams before they can be tested at all, not just more test
methods. The pure view models are the reachable next step.
